# Pulse: Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode analytics

> Pulse is a local-first analytics GUI for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, with Discord Rich Presence. Rust, Tauri 2, Svelte 5 and SQLite own the implementation. Provider access, session history and monetary provenance stay separate. Targeted operating systems are not proof of published installers.

The canonical repository is https://github.com/xt0n1-t3ch/Pulse-Claude-Code-Analytics. This file is a navigation aid for readers and language-model tools, not a promise of search ranking or provider endorsement.

## Start

- [Documentation](docs/index.md): Task-based guide to the current product and maintained references.
- [Install](README.md#install): Downloads and source builds.
- [Preview](README.md#preview): Current application capture and historical previews.
- [Use Pulse](README.md#use-pulse): Claude, Codex, OpenCode and Discord controls.
- [Platform support](docs/maintainers/platforms.md): Actual release availability and native acceptance gaps.

## Models and data

- [Accounts](docs/guides/accounts.md): Independent multi-account connections, native limits, protected profiles and removal.
- [Command Code](docs/guides/command-code.md): Shared CLI/Desktop integration and Discord identity.
- [Storage and migration](docs/guides/storage.md): Pulse-owned data, PULSE_HOME, safe legacy copies and recovery.

- [Claude models and context](docs/models/claude.md): Current Anthropic models, Claude Code capacity, API maxima, prices and runtime gaps.
- [Codex models and context](docs/models/codex.md): Astra and GPT-5.6, exposed Codex capacity, usable budgets, API maxima, current prices and bundled-catalog differences.
- [Context tracking](docs/guides/context.md): Current fill, historical peaks and compaction across providers.
- [Costs](docs/guides/costs.md): Token categories, bundled arithmetic and monetary provenance.
- [OpenCode and Astra](docs/guides/opencode.md): Local SQLite sessions, Go limits and catalog ownership.
- [Plans](docs/guides/plans.md): Provider-specific plan and allowance identity.
